g.text: Illustrative target and filler words from the three instructional conditions
Examples use Q1 to Q4 targets and Q11 to Q14 fillers. Dots indicate contextual co-occurrence, not word-to-word pairing.
Shared targets separate strongly by condition; filler gains are descriptive within each condition
Target and filler performance over time
Target items are identical across conditions. Filler items differ by condition, so the filler panel does not support a between-condition comparison.
